//jql: Which work items appear in the vault. This is the only thing that
decides it: anything the query returns gets a note, anything it stops
returning has its note deleted on the next reconcile.
Types are excluded rather than listed so the Swedish subtask type
'Deluppgift' in the WEB project is included too.
jira.jql: assignee = currentUser() AND issuetype not in (Epic, Story) AND status in ("In Progress", "In Review") ORDER BY updated DESC
jira.//targetSubdir: Where the notes live, relative to the vault root. This folder is owned by the sync.
jira.//taskContext: TaskNotes context, this is what the Work tasks base filters on.
jira.//reviewStatus: TaskNotes status for Jira 'In Review'. Your TaskNotes config defines only none/open/in-progress/done, so leave this as in-progress until you add an in-review status.
jira.//reconcileCron: Safety net behind the webhook, because webhooks get dropped.

backup.//endpoint: Cloudflare R2: https://<account-id>.r2.cloudflarestorage.com. null for real AWS.

couchdb.//: Only used for the raw encrypted backup artifact. Credentials stay in the environment.
